messages:
sam: quick heads-up — preparing to onboard zeta-7b weights. HF path: hf://redwood/zeta-7b/weights v1 (still private). I pushed a presigned mirror URL to the registry bucket. Need a quick perms + checksum sanity check before we trigger the ingest job.

claire: thanks. can you paste the S3 path? I'll run checksum and confirm tokenizer patch.

sam: s3://redwood-registry/artifacts/zeta-7b/v1/weights.tar.gz
presign: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-registry/…?X-Amz-Signature=xxx
sha256: 3f8b9c2e5a7f9b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4
size: 5.2G
note: manifest includes tokenizer.json (hf tokenizer) and shard-manifest.json

ryan: quick check — our ingest expects gzipped tarball + manifest sha256 in metadata. Is the manifest.digest field populated?

sam: yes manifest.digest = sha256:3f8b9c2e5a7f9b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4 (same as file). but noticed tokenizer.vocab size = 50256 and tokenizer config has 'do_lower_case': false — may need a compatibility flag on serving.

maya: tokenizer quirk alert: HF tokenizer uses legacy unk token name '<unk>' but our tokenizer mapping expects '[UNK]'. Will add a compatibility layer in registry metadata. Also watch out for byte-level tokenization differences on CJK.

claire: i'll run checksum now, give me ~5m

infra-bot: ingest pipeline job queued: job_id=ingest-2105001234, started by sam

claire: checksum confirmed. sha256 matches. uploaded presign TTL looks ok (12h). perms: object ACL=private, bucket policy allows read for registry-service role.

ryan: on serving config — recommend config flags: "tokenizer_compat": "legacy-unk", "vocab_size": "50256", "use_byte_level": "auto". also set quantize_profile: none for now.

maya: small nit — shard-manifest has relative paths, our mirrorer expects absolute s3 paths. I'll patch manifest in staging and rerun mirror dry-run.

sam: patch applied to staging manifest at s3://redwood-staging/artifacts/zeta-7b/v1/shard-manifest.json. mirrorer dry-run passed, checksums ok. pushing for production mirror after code review.

claire: ping @ryan for quick CR on the manifest patch (2 lines).

ryan: reviewing now. LGTM, only change was prefixing s3://redwood-registry/... to each shard entry. also added 'origin=hf' metadata.

maya: one more verification: tokenizer.json includes 'added_tokens' empty — confirm serving fallback will handle unknown tokens without crashing.

sam: confirmed, runtime fallback uses byte fallback path. I'll annotate the registry artifact with 'runtime_fallback=byte' and 'QA:checksum=ok'.

claire: thanks everyone. schedule: we'll start mirror->ingest->validate canary tomorrow 10:00 PT. I'll create a calendar invite and add runbook.

sam: perfect :thumbsup:
